figures.caption_en: Session builds per graded privileged trial (reward.json agent_sessions; one dot per trial, green = success, red = failure). Four trials with all-zero telemetry (3 Sol, 1 Luna) are omitted.

unevidenced.reason: Mechanism (c) beyond Opus stand_pages (shown under rw2) and (d) cases (cube knocked onto the floor; cup creeping at 2 mm/s) not figured: time budget; Astra's stand_pages prop (TqzJMuw) not figured. The privileged videos stop at the cut, so 'what happens after the cut' is shown only where the agent itself printed post-cut states (Sol stand_pages probe, Sol ball trace, Astra hold_cup at 579/759); no simulation was run.

Privileged trials have no trajectory.npz in the snapshot or via the fetch service (verifier/trajectory.npz and artifacts/data/trajectory.npz returned http404 for every requested trial), so gripper-width time series could not be plotted; the cover_with_lid hold is shown from the wrist camera instead.

Gemini's and DeepSeek's rejected tent ideas (text quotes only) and Sol/Sol6.1 mid-fall cuts other than xrmbeVo are not figured. Wall minutes for the phases of hR6V9Qw cannot be mapped (no per-step timestamps; the log prints control_steps only at the end).

The ball inside the opaque bottle is invisible in every camera, so the tunnelling step itself is evidenced by Sol's printed per-step trace and Opus' measured end position, not by pixels. The other six standard failures (early spills: Astra F5bbamF, Luna, DeepSeek, ...) are not figured.
Luna's other three standard losses (retrieve_cube tube tipping, gap_retrieve 42 submits / 772 steps, the 5th task) and the 'recovered in 3 of 3 successes, 0 of 8 failures' statistic are not figured.
Per-build wall time and 'GLM ~31 of 90 min in builds' would need build timestamps per session; only counts are in reward.json, so the chart shows counts and the 50-120 s figure from the build logs.
